name: Kazuma
source: Spirit of a child who died of heart disease. He's a poltergeist, he has the ability to move objects with his mind. Unlike the other ghosts in the story, he's not visible to regular humans. He's a bright and cheerful boy. For a little kid, he's oddly gallant. [spoiler]He originally stayed in the mortal realm to comfort his grieving mother. He wants to take [url=https://vndb.org/c53068]Pochi[/url] as his bride. He haunts the science lab storage room.[spoiler]
